x: In the M60's Laurie Forster had improved on '91 with 29:28, clear of Derek Thomas and Charlie Walker. Positions in each age group, outside of the first three, are those in the overall race.
Pat ignored the Barnet warnings that Laurie Forster was catching him and ran a blinder, pulling away even further and producing the second fastest leg of the afternoon (24:08).

Charlie Walker ran hard to hold Barnet to a minute and a half and on the next leg Pat Newell pulled 8 seconds back on Laurie Forster. However, Laurie had an impossible task and although he closed to within 13 seconds of J.
Charlie did more than enough to keep ahead of Barnet's Laurie Forster. Bert Stroud is not quite as fit as last year but did well to finish 15th although he did look very tired on the last lap.

Charlie Walker, perhaps still not at his best after recent injury, nevertheless kept Belgrave well in touch in the 60's losing another 44 seconds to Barnet's Laurie Forster, but more importantly keeping the gap to less than a minute.
Laurie was well out in front, Pat was running strongly ahead of Laurie Forster of Barnet, and Charlie Walker, with his bad leg holding out well, was just behind Derek Wood.

But with Laurie Forster and John Wood back to their best, Charlie Walker not going too well and Bert Stroud rather unfit after his holiday, it was Barnet who had pulled into a 26 second lead by the end of the third leg.
